producer_report.summary: I split drain.rs into six child modules under crates/athena-cli/src/drain/. Production lines in drain.rs went from 4585 to 1192, measured as the lines before the first #[cfg(test)]. The tests stay in drain.rs, with the same 69 #[test] functions. The new files are engine.rs (594 non-blank lines), item_work.rs (1014), rounds.rs (410), lander.rs (189), lifecycle.rs (543) and real_steps.rs (539), so each is under 1500. The engine alone was about 2060 lines, so it needed three files. Function bodies are unchanged. The only edits are pub(super) visibility on moved items, fields and methods, plus `mod` and `pub use` lines in drain.rs, so the crate::drain paths used by main.rs and display.rs still resolve. CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Unreleased / Changed with the measured before and after numbers. clippy, fmt and the policy test pass. `cargo test -p athena-cli -q` passes in every suite; one earlier non-quiet run exited 101 and I could not see why, because the output was truncated.

checks_run.note: all suites pass, 126 lib tests (same as before: 69 #[test] in drain.rs unchanged). The first non-quiet run exited 101 in a late parallel:: test, which the output truncation hid; the quiet rerun passed fully. Probably flaky; not investigated.
workspace crate compiles; main.rs and display.rs untouched

criteria_check.criterion: Production lines of crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs (everything before the first #[cfg(test)] module) are fewer than 1500. Check by Grep for '^#\[cfg\(test\)\]' with line numbers in drain.rs and reading the first match; the line before it is the production line count.
criteria_check.evidence: Grep '^#\[cfg\(test\)\]' in drain.rs: first match at line 1193, so 1192 production lines. Before the change the first match was line 4586 (4585 production lines).

criteria_check.criterion: New files under crates/athena-cli/src/drain/ (at least lifecycle.rs, real_steps.rs, lander.rs, engine.rs) each have fewer than 1500 production lines, checked by Grep for line numbers of the first #[cfg(test)] or the file length via Read.
criteria_check.evidence: Six files, none with a test module. Non-blank line counts: engine 594, item_work 1014 (1043 total by Read), rounds 410, lander 189, lifecycle 543, real_steps 539. All under 1500.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff (git diff) only moves code, adds mod and re-export lines, and adjusts imports or visibility such as pub(super). No function body logic changes, and crate::drain public paths used by main.rs and display.rs (guarded, DrainState, StopOutcome, RestartOutcome and others) remain exported from drain.
criteria_check.evidence: Moves were done by a line-range copy tool that also added pub(super) to private items, fields and inherent methods, with rustfmt applied after. drain.rs gains mod lines and pub use engine/lander/lifecycle/real_steps::*. main.rs and display.rs are unedited and the workspace compiles.

criteria_check.criterion: No test is deleted, ignored or edited beyond import paths: the #[cfg(test)] modules stay in drain.rs (or move with their code) with the same test function names. Check with git diff and Grep for '#\[test\]' counts before and after.
criteria_check.evidence: All test modules stay in drain.rs untouched. Grep '#\[test\]' on drain*: 69 in drain.rs before, 69 after, 0 in drain/. The same test names run.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Changed that describes the split and states only what is true after the measurement (drain.rs under 1500 production lines).
criteria_check.evidence: Entry added under Unreleased / Changed, written after the measurement: 4585 before, 1192 after, each new file under 1100 (largest is 1043 lines).

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`: it passes with the same number of tests as before the change (outcome check: drain behavior is unchanged).
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-cli -q` passed in every suite (126 lib tests, 187, 77, ...). A first non-quiet run exited 101 with output truncated; the rerun was all green.
I ran `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, which was clean, and `cargo fmt --all --check`, which passed. Athena reruns both.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo build`: the whole workspace compiles, so main.rs and display.rs callers need no edits.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test compiled the workspace crates with no edits to main.rs or display.rs. I did not run a separate `cargo build`.

open_issues: One non-quiet `cargo test -p athena-cli` run exited 101 in the parallel:: tests; the output was truncated and the quiet rerun passed. A possible flaky test, unconfirmed.
The mod/pub use block in drain.rs sits just before the first test module; the module doc at the top of drain.rs does not describe the new layout.
mistakes: My first splitter reset its impl tracking on blank lines, so methods stayed private. I fixed it by re-running the pass on the new files.
The first split pulled the doc comment of batches_tests into real_steps.rs. I moved it back above batches_tests in drain.rs.
learnings: drain.rs had 4585 production lines (first #[cfg(test)] at 4586), not the stale 1798 figure.
The Drain engine alone was about 2060 lines, so it needed three files (engine, item_work, rounds), not one.
Child modules use `use super::*;`; glob `pub use` re-exports keep crate::drain paths and the tests' `use super::*` working.
Tests reach private methods and fields of moved items, so those became pub(super).
desires: A shell-free way to move line ranges between files; I used a throwaway cargo program, now deleted.
